title: set --parent re-derives only the item's own status and leaves its draft subtasks draft in an active sprint
goal: backlog.py set --parent gives the item's draft or todo descendants the status the new parent's sprint gives the item (todo in an active sprint, draft in a planned one), as move does for a story's tasks, so a task moved under a story of an active sprint does not keep a draft subtask that next never offers. Found by the SP-hyp6o7hl review.
